facts.why: No page I opened (Wikipedia, Wikiquote, ESL Notes guide) gives the formula's colour, so 'blue' is unconfirmed. The same word is in the printed drink name 'Sherman's blue formula lemonade'.

vibe.verdict: The Klump dinner table is the right home for it, with the chicken skin, Mama's 'don't break gas', Roseanne, Buddy's six T-bones and the Rocky Road gag all true; Hartley's crab cakes and the dinner rolls are filler.
